items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: But it was his nephew, he used to play drums with Danny too. So I can't remember which drum it was at the time.

ctx.x: family. How long were you all together? Oh man, I must have been with him about four or

five years. About four or five years I would imagine. That's what I'm saying. If I could find my other little book that I had around the house. I played with various... I always with somebody, some group. Then I left Edgar and I went, I think I went with Danny's band, Danny White's. Danny White. Yeah, I played with Danny. See, I don't remember who was in the band. I know it was Ernest Holland, he played tenor sax. Probably Curtis Mitchell. Curtis used to do the writing, the arranging. Let me see. It was either…
his real name. I think it was Hawkins, but I know it's Ernest. I think it's Hawkins. Look,
